name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold down 9% in three months, crossing the 8% fall Watch line
state: Gold futures were near $3,919 early on 2 Nov, 9.0% lower over three months and 3.8% down on the week, past the 8% three-month fall that marks Watch. The slide during the Gulf war is consistent with rising yields and Fed tightening rather than a flight to safety.
for_you: Gold prices are falling faster than usual; holders of gold or gold funds are seeing larger value swings.
rubric_hit: Gold 3m change −9.0%, beyond the −8% Watch line
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
